title: JumpInside Command
description: Jump inside a room for a first interior shot: the Perspective view stands just inside the room's door (of several, the one with the longest view; with none, a corner along the longest diagonal), 1.2 m above the floor, looking across to the far wall with a 24 mm lens. The shot is saved as the named view "Interior: <room>", replaced when asked again.

room.description: The room's id, name or type. Omit for the picked room, else the only one.
